source_note: Verified Historia ya Tanzania na Maadili Form One schemes of work (Arusha Catholic Seminary, ARUCASE) for Term I and Term II. 2 periods per week (1 x 80-min double period + 1 x 40-min single period). Term I covers Sura 1-4 (main competences 1.0-4.0); Term II covers Sura 5-7 (main competences 5.0-7.0). Week 10 of each term is mid-term assessment and break.
